items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond came in there that night and Wettling and I had taken John Hammond to some flat on South Parkway.

ctx.x: Well it's very nice to put this on record because one of the things about the successful people like Mnesuhi is that there are always people willing to knock successful people. Another example......
You know the first time John Hammond heard Meade Lux play?
